quadrilaterals earlier.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Any polygon with 4 sides
is called a quadrilateral.

clips.speaker: swiftee

quadrilateral ABCD.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
This is a special type
of quadrilateral.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Let's see what
makes it special.

clips.text: These two sides look like they will meet.

clips.speaker: swiftee

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: Woah! The sides meet.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Let's check the other
pair of sides.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
This pair of sides
does not meet.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: This means the sides are parallel to each other.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: A B is parallel to C D.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: Here's the big secret!

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
One pair of parallel sides
is enough.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Then a quadrilateral
is a trapezium!

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: Which of these quadrilaterals is a trapezium?

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: Correct!

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: It has one pair of parallel sides.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: So it's a trapezium!

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: So it's not a trapezium.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: This shape has no parallel sides at all.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
The parallel sides
are called bases.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
The other two sides
are called legs.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: A trapezium is a quadrilateral with at least one pair of parallel sides.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: The parallel sides are called the bases.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: The other two sides are called the legs.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: A scalene trapezium has sides of different lengths.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: An isosceles trapezium has legs of the same length.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: A right trapezium has two adjacent right angles.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: Two angles that add up to 180° are supplementary.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: *Great* job!

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: You know all about *trapeziums!*
